subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should Auto-TTS keep using other configured speech providers as fallbacks when the selected provider is skipped or fails, or should OpenClaw expose/enable provider stickiness for configured providers?
rationale: Current docs and tests make fallback deliberate, but this report shows the fallback can surprise users and obscure billing/provider expectations; automation should not choose that policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
options.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

options.title: Keep fallback-only behavior
options.body: Close the remaining behavior as expected after improving docs/status messaging enough that users understand why OpenAI may play.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Make configured providers sticky by default and require an upgrade note because existing fallback setups may stop producing audio.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in provider stickiness
recommendation.body: Keep fallback as the compatibility default, but expose a documented strict mode that fails visibly instead of playing another provider when the selected provider cannot be used.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent current-main ownership signal on the speech-core TTS surface, while the remaining decision is cross-cutting fallback policy.
